1 Growth Data Analyst (f/m/d) Your Role
 * You manage tracking systems and analytics tools like Google Analytics, and Google Tag Manager to track user behavior across digital touchpoints.
 * You monitor and ensure data accuracy by validating tracking setups, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining data integrity across platforms.
 * You analyze user behavior and customer journeys to identify trends, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities.
 * You create and maintain dashboards for key metrics like acquisition, retention, and conversion to support data-driven decision-making.
 * You support A/B testing by analyzing results and evaluating impact on key performance indicators.
 * You conduct customer segmentation to enable targeted marketing based on behavior and engagement.
 * You collaborate with our marketing, product, and engineering teams to align tracking and growth initiatives.
 * You deliver actionable insights by translating data analysis into clear recommendations to optimize growth.
 * You perform forecasting and predictive analytics to support planning and identify future growth opportunities.

Job Requirements
 * You bring 3+ years of experience in digital, growth, or marketing analytics within tech or scale-up environments; a degree in Data Science, Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field is a plus.
 * You bring hands-on experience in e-commerce and digital marketing, with a strong understanding of online customer acquisition, conversion optimization, retention strategies, and the key commercial metrics that drive sustainable growth.
 * You can translate complex data into actionable growth insights that drive acquisition, conversion, and retention.
 * You demonstrate a deep understanding of data layers, analytical tools (e.g., GA4), and tracking systems within GDPR compliance.
 * You have proficiency in building and utilizing BI dashboards (e.g., Data Studio, Metabase) to visualize and clarify complex data.
 * You use Excel/Google Sheets confidently; SQL and AI-powered analytics tools are a strong plus.
 * You think strategically, keep the bigger picture in mind, and understand the interdependencies between marketing channels.
 * You understand key digital growth metrics and how data drives marketing and product decisions.
 * You are fluent in English; additional language proficiency, such as German, is highly valued.
 * You are a self-driven, structured, and detail-oriented professional who thrives in fast-paced, cross-functional teams.

Why Us.
 * Work-Life Balance: We offer working time models that suit different lifestyles. In addition to our flexible working hours, you can work from home up to three days per week.
 * Workation: Combine work with exploring new places. At Nuki, you can enjoy up to three weeks of workation per year.
 * Good times together: Once a week, we enjoy breakfast together. Free coffee, tea, regional juices, and seasonal fruit are always available. We also love spending time together outside of work - for example at our two-day team event or our beach volleyball tournament.
 * Grow your skills: Develop yourself through internal Nuki Academy seminars, workshops, language courses, and free Udemy offerings, or choose further training of your choice.
 * Green mobility: We support sustainable mobility and cover the cost of your annual public transport ticket (Klimaticket). Alternatively, parking spaces and charging stations for electric cars are available in our garage.
 * Additional days off: You receive 26 vacation days per year - December 24 and 31 are additional days off.

For the advertised position, a minimum salary of € 3,954,- gross per month applies according to the collective agreement (no all-in). Willingness to significantly overpay if you have the appropriate qualifications. This position is open for applications in Graz.

We look forward to getting to know you!

OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We br... 1 Software Engineer - Engine Integration (m/f/d) Job description
Our Product Engineers are domain experts first, developers second. They build Engines - the simulations and models that capture how buildings actually behave - fast, and increasingly with AI. But these prototypes live on GitHub and only run on laptops: untested against the platform, unavailable to customers.

That's the gap you close. You're the key counterpart to our Product Engineers: you understand what an Engine computes, how, and why - well enough to decide where each piece belongs, hand off what belongs to other teams, and build the rest yourself. No finished spec lands in your inbox. You read other people's code, ask the right questions, and turn a working prototype into a service we can run and trust. We work in a strongly agentic way - so will you.

Your mission
 * Run our Engines and make them better - correct, fast, observable. When results look wrong, you can tell whether it's the data, the integration, or the physics.

 * Onboard new prototypes - understand the method and edge cases; judge what's production-ready and what needs a rewrite.

 * Find the right home for each function - decompose monoliths and define the interfaces and data contracts that make those boundaries real.

 * Integrate - with Planning and our Systems Architects, translating between domain and platform language, then build what remains yourself.

 * Make the next Engine easier than the last - shape the conventions that let prototypes arrive closer to integration-ready.

You won't do this alone: DevOps, App/Experience, AI, and Data & Flows already own their domains.

Your profile
 * Several years of professional software engineering across the stack, centre of gravity in the backend.

 * Python and TypeScript - strong in one, comfortable in the other, attached to neither.

 * The ability to read and judge code you didn't write, including scientific and numerical code.

 * A low-ego, collaborative style with domain experts, and the skill to explain trade-offs to people who think in physics, not architecture.

 * Professional English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

Nice-to-have

 * Geometry in code (computational geometry, meshes, CAD or BIM/IFC).

 * Simulation and numerical methods (thermal/energy simulation, FEM/CFD, solvers).

 * Real experience with AI and agentic workflows.

 * Productionizing research or prototype code (ML pipelines, scientific computing, quant models).

 * Building-industry or energy-domain exposure.

Why us?
 * Real impact. The Engines you integrate don't sit in a demo - they feed real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - you work across a complete product portfolio, not isolated one-off projects. Every Engine you bring in has a real place in the whole.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option and a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000 - €75,000 gross/year, depending on your experience.

About us
OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it!

jobs.occupation: Postgraduate at the Energy Research Centre (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
For a current research project in the fields of data-driven thermal modelling, simulation, and optimization of an industrial production facility with high temperature heat pump integration, the Energy Research Centre at FHV is seeking a PhD researcher to contribute to innovative solutions for the industrial energy transition. 1 Postgraduate at the Energy Research Centre (m/w/d) Dornbirn, 75%

Your Role(s)

 * _ Energy Researcher: You work on scientific questions in the field of sustainable industrial energy systems and develop application-oriented technical solutions

_ Modeler and Analyst: You develop models of thermal energy systems and analyze complex relationships using data-driven and simulation-based approaches

_ Simulation and Optimization Developer: You design and implement simulation and optimization approaches for energy-related applications and processes

_ Project Partner: You collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, actively contributing your expertise to the research project

_ Science Communicator: You document research results, present your work in project meetings, and publish your findings in scientific journals and conference proceedings

_ PhD Candidate: You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your ability to conduct independent research within the framework of a doctoral dissertation at a partner university

Your Qualifications

 * _ You hold a completed Master's degree in a technical field such as Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a comparable discipline.

_ You are passionate about energy-related topics and motivated to contribute actively to solutions for the energy transition.

_ You have good knowledge of at least one programming language, such as Python.

_ You work analytically and systematically and enjoy tackling complex technical challenges.

_ You have an interest in applied research and scientific work.

_ You enjoy working in teams and value professional exchange within interdisciplinary research projects.

_ You have good written and spoken English skills.

Your Prospects

 * _ Employment level: 75% (part-time position; active support for completing a doctoral dissertation)

_ Salary: minimum annual gross salary of € 42.155 (75%-employment). Actual compensation depends on qualifications and experience.

_ Online application deadline: 16 September 2026

_ Fixed-term contract: October 2026 - September 2029

_ You can also find our benefits at: http://www.fhv.at/karriere

Our Spirit

 * _ Quality & Innovation: We share knowledge, educate future professionals, conduct research with partners throughout Europe, and help shape the future for coming generations.

_ Individuality & Development: Flexible working models, compatibility of family and career, diversity, and personal development are central values for us.

_ Flexibility & Collaboration: A collegial and appreciative environment, creative freedom, and shared celebrations are part of everyday life on our campus.

We are happy to answer your questions regarding the position or the application process:

Regarding the position: Prof. (FH) Dr. Peter Kepplinger, peter.kepplinger@fhv.at, +43 5572 792 3801

Regarding the application: Freya Rickenbacher, BA, freya.rickenbacher@fhv.at, +43 5572 792 2138

Jetzt bewerben

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Sales Lead Poland (m/f/d) Your role:

You own the Poland market on the sales side. You'll build and lead a high-performing AE & SDR team from the ground up - hiring, ramping, coaching and holding the bar on day-to-day execution.

You stay close to the front line: running deals yourself when it matters, jumping into demos and discovery calls, and setting the standard for how we sell in Poland.

You own the Polish sales number - monthly and yearly targets - and you're accountable for a reliable forecast. You work hand in hand with Marketing on lead-gen for the PL market and with Customer Success on clean handoffs.

You translate what works in DACH into the polish context, feed learnings back to the leadership team, and shape how the whole polish sales motion scales.

What's waiting for you:

 * Market ownership: Full responsibility for fonio's sales performance in Poland.

 * Team building: Hire, ramp and coach the polish AE & SDR team as we scale.

 * Player-coach: Lead from the front - stay in deals and demos, not just dashboards.

 * Quota ownership: Clear monthly and yearly targets for the PL market - you?re setting it up for the team.

 * Cross-functional impact: Close collaboration with Marketing, Customer Success and the founders.

 * Build, don't maintain: Shape the Polish sales motion in a fast-scaling startup.

What we offer:

 * €70,000 - 100,000 (base + uncapped commission; depending on experience)

 * On-site in Warsaw (with a 2-month onboarding on-site in Vienna to start)

 * Top equipment of your choice and extremely short decision paths

 * Direct line to the founders and real ownership over an entire market

What you bring:

 * Several years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of closing along a clear funnel

 * First leadership or team-lead experience

 * Strong product and technology understanding

 * Polish at native level and confident, fluent English; German is a strong plus

 * Startup mindset - builder mentality

Hiring process

 * 15 min Intro call

 * 60 min Skill Interview with our CCO Alex Brix

 * 20 min Language & Team Fit

 * 20 min Culture Interview

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Ex Commercial Founder (m/f/d) Your Role

As Ex Commercial Founder at fonio, you own one of our products. You're not just shaping the roadmap; you're accountable for the commercial success of the product. Strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and growth all sit with you.

You'll operate like a mini-CEO for your product: making the calls, running the experiments, and carrying the numbers. You won't do it alone: you're paired with a technical counterpart and together you own the product.

What you'll do

 * Own a product - from strategy and roadmap to go-to-market and revenue

 * Define positioning, pricing, and the commercial strategy for your product

 * Work directly with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship and grow fast

 * Own the metrics that matter - adoption, retention, and revenue - and be accountable for them

 * Run discovery: talk to customers, validate problems, and decide what gets built

What We Offer

 * Up to €150.000 OTE + equity.

 * On-site in Vienna, Munich, Barcelona or London - relocation package to Vienna if needed.

 * Real ownership of a fonio product: you get to essentially work like an entrepreneur inside of fonio.

 * Maximum autonomy - you run your product like your own company.

 * Everything you need to be successful - if you need it - you?ll get it.

What You Bring

 * Demonstrated track record as a founder or commercial owner - you've built and launched a B2B SaaS product & owned it end to end from the commercial side.

 * Strong commercial instinct: you think in terms of markets, customers, and revenue

 * Comfortable operating with high ambiguity and no predefined structure

 * Sharp analytical thinking paired with a bias for execution

 * Excellent communication in English; German is a strong plus given our DACH focus

 * Bonus: experience with AI products, B2B SaaS, or voice technology
